text: The ZHoly3O ferment contains more than just fermented beet juice, but you can ferment your own beet juice or even use other ferments. I found fermented beet made with apple vinegar and salt was best so far, though kimchi and kombucha also helped. Most yogurts weren't fermented enough to work, and apple vinegar by itself only helped a little. Smelling the ferment helps a lot. Drinking a spoonful can also help, although it may cause itching in somebody who breaks down histamine poorly, which then requires activated charcoal to reduce gut histamine.
reader: somebody about to take a psychedelic, or to sit with a friend who has, who wants a ferment ready for when the nausea comes and is deciding what to buy or make
